label: Two-maxima control separates 'every maximum in being is GOD_2' from reduced naming (inference)
meaning: Strictness control: on Bool with everything in act, nothing more a being, no causing and no GOD_2, uniqueness of a maximum fails (the causing condition also fails), so the reduced naming holds vacuously, while true is maximal and not GOD_2. A finite interpretation only; it shows the reduced naming does not entail that every maximum in being is GOD_2, not that two maxima in being exist.
